entries.prompt: Draw a small single-purpose industrial machine, isometric, that takes one four-part fact card and files it. A hopper of stacked cards on the left feeds a toothed guard wheel engraved with a short code; a duplicate card is turned aside into a small reject tray. A two-column press in the middle stamps a card flat into a long ribbon of words, and a diverter sends the ribbon to two index bins, one a drawer of cards and one a tape spool. At the front a six-station turntable, one seat per ordering of the three parts, receives the card. Muted four-tone metal, one tiny engraved label, no diagram arrows or captions; the machine should look like it exists. Output one self-contained interactive HTML page: stepping across the bench advances a card through the stages and lights the next turntable seat.
entries.rights: MIT
entries.title: Quad intake
entries.creator: wazootech
entries.description: An independent knowledge-retrieval example.

entries.prompt: Draw a small single-purpose industrial machine, isometric, that physically fuses two ranked lists. Two tall open magazines of flat slips—one labelled for keyword search, one for vector search—feed a slotted revolver drum in the middle that interleaves the two rankings into one queue on a rail, best slip first. A carriage with a down-pointing needle slides along the rail, a round dial reads a fused score, and from the top slip a thread runs through two eyelets to an answer card clipped on a board at the back. Muted four-tone metal, one tiny engraved label, no diagram arrows or captions; the machine should look like it exists. Output one self-contained interactive HTML page: hovering across the rail parks the carriage and updates the needle and readout.
entries.rights: MIT
entries.title: Hybrid recall
entries.creator: wazootech
entries.description: An independent knowledge-retrieval example.
